text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, a massive recreational event, "Umamusume Tag," using the training course was supposed to be held... or so it was planned—

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... The rain has finally let up a bit, but...
maybe coming here today was a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yikes... the track is a total mess. Can we even play tag like this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Due to the unfortunate rain, the spirits of both the fans who came to watch
and the participating Umamusume were dampened.
Amidst growing whispers that it might even be cancelled—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh...! Whyyy?!
El was looking forward to this for days!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was supposed to show everyone
how gorgeously I could dodge the tagger...
I can't do that like this, no way, desu...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Why~?
That's not true at all, El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... But in this kind of condition,
the crowd won't even be able to get hyped—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No, no, that makes no sense, you know?
Please remember, El!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Even on rainy days... races are still held, AREN'T THEY?
Besides, the crowd gets even more fired up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Then tag is the same thing, YES!
It is far too early to give up, MA'AM!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Give up...! That's right, that is so riiiight!
Giving up over something like this isn't like El at aall!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Because a true wrestler... always gets the crowd pumped up, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!! Let's go,
Taiki-senpai! Time to enter the ring, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Roger and consent♪ I'm the ogre, right?!
Let's go!

text_block_list.name: El & Taiki
text_block_list.text: Heeeeeere it cooooooooomes~...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? What incredible running...!
Even on a track condition like this...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Give me a break... running in this
is gonna get mud all the way inside my shoes.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
But... seeing something like that,
how could I not get all fired up?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... thanks to the fiery running of the two,
everyone who was feeling down got hyped up,
and the "game of tag" drew to a close amid fierce excitement!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~! How d'you like that!
El's run cleared up the whole sky!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That was an unbelievable run, El!
I couldn't catch up to you until the very end!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Like a condor soaring through the storm!
I feel like I've gotten the hang of running in the rain!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Whew, once you got tagged, you chased immediately, and once you tagged someone, you ran for it!
It was an endless, heated battle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The audience was super hyped too!
We are the best entertainers!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still... the ones who enjoyed it the most were
definitely El and Taiki-senpai theeeeemselves!
